deviations: Pull request intake uses org.tangled.ci.triggerPipeline with an org.tangled.event.pullRequest trigger. Tangled itself starts pull request runs from Jetstream records, which Kiln does not consume.
Kiln does not take Tangled webhooks as input, because their payloads lack the repository DID. The HMAC format signs and verifies Kiln's status projection only.
The knot and approver identities are pinned in the profile. They are not resolved from the repository DID document or from collaborator records.
No deployment binary or Lattice WorkflowPort wiring is included; server::serve takes a caller-supplied WorkflowPort.
known_tradeoffs: Workflow statuses for an unknown outcome are reported as pending with an error, because Tangled has no unknown status.
Pipeline ids are kiln- plus 32 hex digits of a BLAKE3 identity, not TIDs. The knot accepts them; whether the app view does is unverified.
The #12 gate number of a Tangled pull request is derived from the BLAKE3 hash of its AT-URI.
Tangled schedules are refused, because the H-field hash seeds differ.
